releaseNotes: v0.1.0 (beta): Local monitoring of Bambu Lab printers over the LAN: print state, stage, progress, time left, layers, temperatures (including H2 series), speed, HMS errors and a dashboard tile. Chamber light switch and one device per AMS unit with humidity, temperature and filament per tray. Optional pause, resume, stop and speed (newer firmware needs Developer Mode). One Log level, dark mode.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Bambu Lab Integration
apps.description: Adds your Bambu Lab printers by IP, serial and access code, and lets you choose which light and AMS devices Hubitat creates.

drivers.name: Bambu Lab Printer
drivers.description: One per printer: the local MQTT connection, print status, temperatures, errors, tile and optional print control. Created by the app.

drivers.name: Bambu Lab AMS
drivers.description: One per AMS unit: humidity, temperature, and filament type, color and amount for each tray.
